newsitem.title: USA: Javelin in deal with Riva Electronics.
newsitem.headline: Javelin in deal with Riva Electronics.

text.p: TUSTIN, Calif., Javelin Systems Inc Monday said it signed a letter of intent with Riva Electronics Ltd under which Riva will distribute about $24 million in Jaevlin products over a three year period.

In a statement, the Tustin, Calif-based provider of open-system, touch screen point of sale terminals said Riva will be its exclusive distributor in Western Europe, Scandinavia, Eastern Europe and the former countries of the Soviet Union. A definitive agreement is expected to be signed in the next 30 days.
